I have resolved the issue by updating the MySQL backend to use the non-deprecated `database` and `password` options instead of `db` and `passwd`:

- Updated [`DatabaseWrapper.get_connection_params()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-37m4ds7c/django/db/backends/mysql/base.py#L194-L230) in [base.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-37m4ds7c/django/db/backends/mysql/base.py) to set `kwargs['database']` and `kwargs['password']` instead of `kwargs['db']` and `kwargs['passwd']`.
- Updated [`DatabaseClient.settings_to_cmd_args_env()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-37m4ds7c/django/db/backends/mysql/client.py#L8-L60) in [client.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-37m4ds7c/django/db/backends/mysql/client.py) to check `settings_dict['OPTIONS']['database']` before falling back to `'db'` and `settings_dict['NAME']`.
